newsitem.title: GERMANY: Frankfurt Oct passenger figures rise 0.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Frankfurt Oct passenger figures rise 0.3 pct.

text.p: Passenger numbers at Frankfurt airport rose 0.3 percent to 3.67 million in October due to a slight seasonal rise in business travel, Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG) said.
But leisure travel demand at Germany's international gateway was curbed by the country's stagnating economy, the latest FAG monthly traffic report said.
Traffic to the most popular tourist destinations in southern and south-eastern Europe fell last month, it added.
"By contrast, incoming tourism was picking up again after a long period of sluggishness," the report added.
Passenger numbers at Frankfurt airport have risen 1.4 percent to 33.13 million over the first ten months of the year, the report showed. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
